items.question: Does LSI Gold Digger tell me what to trade?
items.answer: No. It is a research and analysis tool. It does not give financial advice, and its analysis does not guarantee returns.

items.question: Can it connect to my XM account or place trades?
items.answer: No. XM connectivity and trade execution are not implemented and not approved. They will only be shown as available if that changes.

items.question: Where does the market data come from?
items.answer: Data sources, timestamps and refresh intervals will be documented before the first release.
